findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Yogurts for breakfast service were not kept on ice. These items were returned to the reach in cooler where they were found to be 55F internally. The yogurts were discarded. Yogurt reads keep refrigerated on the label. Take care to properly handle food according to label directions. The violation is considered corrected at the time of inspection. 

(A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.
